subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14 exact-SHA action upgrades be accepted as one grouped change across secret-bearing, security-scanning, and release workflows after the rebased head passes its gates?
rationale: CI can catch execution failures, but it cannot decide whether maintainers accept the grouped supply-chain and rollback scope for workflows that handle credentials and publishing authority.

options.title: Approve Grouped Update
options.body: Rebase, complete the exact-head workflow gates, and merge the grouped exact-SHA upgrades if the sensitive workflow results remain clean.

options.title: Split Sensitive Actions
options.body: Separate Codex Action, GitHub App token, Docker publishing, and CodeQL upgrades into smaller PRs for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Pause This Batch
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place until the upstream releases have more operational history or a narrower dependency batch is available.

recommendation.title: Approve Grouped Update
recommendation.body: Rebase, complete the exact-head workflow gates, and merge the grouped exact-SHA upgrades if the sensitive workflow results remain clean.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans project-wide release, CI, credential, and workflow policy, and recent history connects steipete to those operational paths.
